title: Third-party notices
summary: Attribution and licensing notices for upstream Grimoire/vpkmerge, ffmpeg-static/FFmpeg, and ChatLane chat wheel icons.
notes: Type ADR taken from MANIFEST_TYPE (authoritative). Content is prose licensing/attribution notices with no Status field and no Context/Decision/Consequences sections, so locked is false; it does carry binding constraints (retain notices, keep Ko-fi/Discord labels explicit about upstream ownership).
